title: Class Rosters
hints: Keep two maps: course → students and student → courses. Use TreeSet values so names come out sorted.
computeIfAbsent(key, k -> new TreeSet<>()) gets the set for a key, creating it the first time.
add and remove on a Set return true only when something changed: use that to choose the message.

pt-br.title: Listas de turmas
hints: Guarde dois mapas: turma → alunos e aluno → turmas. Use TreeSet nos valores para os nomes saírem ordenados.
computeIfAbsent(chave, k -> new TreeSet<>()) pega o set de uma chave, criando na primeira vez.
add e remove em um Set devolvem true só quando algo mudou: use isso para escolher a mensagem.
mustContain: Use um Map para ligar turmas e alunos.
Use um Set para os nomes, para ninguém aparecer duas vezes.

mustContain.message: Use a Map to link courses and students.
Use a Set for the names, so nobody is listed twice.

tests.input:
6
enroll Ana Math
enroll Bia Math
enroll Ana Art
roster Math
courses Ana
enroll Ana Math
tests.output:
Enrolled Ana in Math
Enrolled Bia in Math
Enrolled Ana in Art
Math: Ana, Bia
Ana: Art, Math
Ana is already in Math

tests.input:
3
roster Music
courses Caio
drop Caio Music
tests.output:
Music has no students
Caio has no courses
Caio is not in Music
